title: JPMorgan 10-K Net Interest Yield
goal: Using SEC EDGAR, open JPMorgan Chase & Co.'s annual report on Form 10-K for fiscal year 2018. In that filing, find the line item "Net interest yield on average interest-earning assets, managed basis" and report its value for each of these periods: 2018 and 2017. Report numbers exactly as printed (keep the filing's units; use negative numbers for values shown in parentheses). If you cannot find the filing or the line item, set found=false and do not guess.

found.description: false if the filing or the line item could not be found

units.description: units as printed in the filing, e.g. 'in millions'

filing_url.description: URL of the 10-K document the values came from

output.notes: Page 58 of JPMorgan Chase & Co.'s 2018 Form 10-K reports 'Net interest yield on average interest-earning assets – managed basis' as 2.50% for 2018 and 2.36% for 2017.
